def symbolic_components(expression,manager):
    value=manager.eval_scalar(pf.Scalar.zero()+expression,sympy_mode=True)
    gram=sp.Matrix(value.inner_prod_coords).applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    funcs=sp.Matrix(list(value.func_coords)).applyfunc(sp.simplify)

def bregman(kernel,u,v):
    return kernel(u)-kernel(v)-kernel.grad(v)*(u-v)

def symbolic_components(expression,manager):
    value=manager.eval_scalar(pf.Scalar.zero()+expression,sympy_mode=True)
    gram=sp.Matrix(value.inner_prod_coords).applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    functions=sp.Matrix(list(value.func_coords)).applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    offset=sp.simplify(sp.sympify(value.offset))
    return gram,functions,offset

def D_of(kernel,u,v):
    return kernel(u)-kernel(v)-kernel.grad(v)*(u-v)

def prox_step(function,x,stepsize,kernel,tag):
    return function.bregman_prox(x,stepsize,kernel,tag=tag)
def symbolic_manager(context,parameters):
return pf.ExpressionManager(context,resolve_parameters=parameters)

def exact_check(name,expression,manager,context):
    value=manager.eval_scalar(pf.Scalar.zero()+expression,sympy_mode=True)
    gram=sp.Matrix(value.inner_prod_coords).applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    funcs=sp.Matrix(list(value.func_coords)).applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    offset=sp.simplify(sp.sympify(value.offset))
    assert all(term==0 for term in [*gram,*funcs,offset]), name
    print(name+': exact Gram, function, and offset residuals are zero.')
    pf.pprint_labeled_matrix(pf.MatrixWithNames(np.asarray(gram,dtype=object),[str(v) for v in context.basis_vectors()],[str(v) for v in context.basis_vectors()]))
    pf.pprint_labeled_matrix(pf.MatrixWithNames(np.asarray(funcs,dtype=object).reshape(1,-1),['function residual'],[str(v) for v in context.basis_scalars()]))
    print('Constant residual:',offset)
    exact_results[name]={'gram_zero':True,'function_zero':True,'offset_zero':True,
                         'gram_shape':list(gram.shape),'function_count':len(funcs)}

def potential(t,x,z,X,x0,G,Lp,Np):
    return -4*(G*z)-2*z**2+(4*Lp/t)*((G+z)*(x-X))+(4*Lp/Np)*(G*(X-x0))

def terminal_potential(X,x0,G,Lp,Np):
    return 2*G**2+(4*Lp/Np)*(G*(X-x0))

def symbolic_components(expression,manager):
    value=manager.eval_scalar(pf.Scalar.zero()+expression,sympy_mode=True)
    gram=sp.Matrix(value.inner_prod_coords).applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    functions=sp.Matrix(list(value.func_coords)).applyfunc(sp.simplify)
    offset=sp.simplify(sp.sympify(value.offset))
    return gram,functions,offset

def verify_exact(name,expression,manager):
    gram,functions,offset=symbolic_components(expression,manager)
    assert all(v==0 for v in [*gram,*functions,offset]),name
    labels=[str(v) for v in manager.context.basis_vectors()] if hasattr(manager,'context') else [str(i) for i in range(gram.rows)]
    pf.pprint_labeled_matrix(np.array(gram,dtype=object),row_labels=labels)
    print(name,'function residual:',functions,'offset residual:',offset,'exact zero:',True)
    exact_residuals[name]={'gram_zero':True,'function_zero':True,'offset_zero':True,'gram_shape':list(gram.shape)}

    function=sp.Matrix(list(value.func_coords)).applyfunc(sp.simplify)

    return gram,function,offset

"def aligned_squares(certificate, ctx):\n",
    "    S=np.asarray(certificate['S_matrix'],dtype=float)\n",
    "    values,vectors=np.linalg.eigh((S+S.T)/2)\n",
    "    assert values.min()>=0, 'This exact numerical alignment requires a PSD saved S'\n",
    "    sqrt_S=(vectors*np.sqrt(values))@vectors.T\n",
    "    decomposition=certificate['numerical_decomposition']\n",
    "    D=np.asarray(decomposition['D'],dtype=float)\n",
    "    E=np.asarray(decomposition['ell_coords'],dtype=float)\n",
    "    assert np.array_equal(D,np.diag(np.diag(D))) and np.diag(D).min()>=0\n",
    "    supplied_factors=np.sqrt(np.diag(D))[:,None]*E\n",
    "    Q,_=polar(supplied_factors@sqrt_S)\n",
    "    aligned=Q@sqrt_S\n",
    "    assert np.allclose(aligned.T@aligned,S,atol=1e-10,rtol=0)\n",
    "    basis=ctx.basis_vectors()\n",
    "    pieces={label:sum((float(coef)*v for coef,v in zip(row,basis)),pf.Vector.zero())**2\n",
    "            for label,row in zip(decomposition['piece_labels'],aligned)}\n",
    "    return pieces,dict(method='polar alignment of supplied factors to saved S',\n",
    "                      factors=aligned.tolist(),factor_max_change=float(np.max(abs(aligned-supplied_factors))),\n",
    "                      reconstruction_max_abs=float(np.max(abs(aligned.T@aligned-S))))\n",

RHS-=step_square(K+1,Horizon,Lp,x,xp,star,F,G)

LHS=phi(sp.S.One,Horizon,Lp,xp,star,F,G)-Lp/(4*Horizon)*(x-star)**2

RHS+=(2*Horizon+1)/((2*Horizon-1)*(2*Horizon))*smooth_residual(F,star,xp,Lp)

RHS+=smooth_residual(F,x,xp,Lp)/(2*Horizon)
RHS-=step_square(sp.S.One,Horizon,Lp,x,xp,star,F,G)
checks['base']=assert_identity('Base N>=2',LHS,RHS,ctx,params)

ctx,F,G,H,star,x,xp=local_context('boundary',Lp)
LHS=H(xp)-H(star)-phi(Horizon-1,Horizon,Lp,x,star,F,G)
RHS=smooth_residual(F,star,xp,Lp)/(Horizon+1)+2/(Horizon+1)*convex_residual(G,star,xp)
RHS+=Horizon/(Horizon+1)*smooth_residual(F,x,xp,Lp)+(Horizon-1)/(Horizon+1)*convex_residual(G,x,xp)
RHS-=step_square(Horizon,Horizon,Lp,x,xp,star,F,G)

ctx,F,G,H,star,x,xp=local_context('one',Lp)

RHS+=convex_residual(G,star,xp)+sp.Rational(1,2)*smooth_residual(F,x,xp,Lp)

def smooth_residual(F,u,v,L):
    return F(v)-F(u)+F.grad(v)*(u-v)+(F.grad(u)-F.grad(v))**2/(2*L)

def convex_residual(G,u,v):
    return G(v)-G(u)+G.grad(v)*(u-v)

def step_square(i,N,L,x,xplus,star,F,G):
    a0,a1,astar=F.grad(x),F.grad(xplus),F.grad(star)
    s=G.grad(xplus)
    c1=N/((2*N+1-i)*(2*N-i)*L)
    u1=i/(2*N)*a1+(2*N-i)/(2*N)*a0-astar
    c2=((i-1)/(2*N-i)*(2*N+2)/(2*N+1)+2*N/((2*N-i)**2*(2*N+1)))/(2*L)
    u2=a0+s-L/(2*N+1-i)*(x-star)
    c3=i/(2*N+1-i)*2*N/(2*N+1)/(2*L)
    u3=(2*N+1)/(2*N)*(a1+s)-(a0+s)/(2*N)-L/(2*N-i)*(xplus-star)
    return c1*u1**2+c2*u2**2+c3*u3**2

def local_context(label,L):
    ctx=pf.PEPContext(label).set_as_current()
    F=pf.SmoothConvexFunction(is_basis=True,tags=[f'f_{{{label}}}'],L=L)
    G=pf.ConvexFunction(is_basis=True,tags=[f'g_{{{label}}}'])
    H=F+G
    star=H.set_stationary_point(f'x_{{star,{label}}}')
    x=pf.Vector(is_basis=True,tags=[f'x_{{{label}}}'])
    xp=G.prox(x-F.grad(x)/L,1/L,tag=f'x_{{plus,{label}}}')
return ctx,F,G,H,star,x,xp

def exact_components(expression,ctx,parameters):
    manager=pf.ExpressionManager(ctx,resolve_parameters=parameters)
    value=manager.eval_scalar(expression,sympy_mode=True)

    funcs=sp.Matrix(list(value.func_coords)).applyfunc(lambda z:sp.factor(sp.cancel(z)))
    offset=sp.factor(sp.cancel(value.offset))

def closed_coefficients(j,n,ell):
    j,n,ell=(cast(sp.Expr,sp.sympify(v)) for v in (j,n,ell))
    C=sp.zeros(4)

    C[1,1]=ell*(n-j)/(2*n-j)**2
    C[1,2]=C[2,1]=-1/(2*(2*n-j))
    C[3,3]=1/(2*ell*(2*n-j))
    return C,(j+1)/(2*n-j),j/(2*n-j)

def local_context(label,base=False):
    ctx=pf.PEPContext(label).set_as_current()
    ff=pf.SmoothConvexFunction(is_basis=True,tags=[f"f_{{{label}}}"],L=LL)
    gg=pf.ConvexFunction(is_basis=True,tags=[f"g_{{{label}}}"])
    hh=ff+gg
    xs=hh.set_stationary_point("x_{star}")
    x=pf.Vector(is_basis=True,tags=["x_{k}"])
    x0=x if base else pf.Vector(is_basis=True,tags=["x_{0}"])
y=gg.prox(x-ff.grad(x)/LL,1/LL,tag="x_{k+1}")
return {"ctx":ctx,"f":ff,"g":gg,"xs":xs,"x":x,"y":y,"x0":x0}

def Q_step(e,i):
    x,y,xs=e["x"],e["y"],e["xs"]
    ff,gg=e["f"],e["g"]
    ap,a,astar=ff.grad(x),ff.grad(y),ff.grad(xs)
    s=gg.grad(y)
    c1=NN/((2*NN+1-i)*(2*NN-i)*LL)
    u1=i/(2*NN)*a+(2*NN-i)/(2*NN)*ap-astar
    c2=((i-1)/(2*NN-i)*(2*NN+2)/(2*NN+1)
        +2*NN/((2*NN-i)**2*(2*NN+1)))/(2*LL)
    u2=ap+s-LL/(2*NN+1-i)*(x-xs)
    c3=i/(2*NN+1-i)*2*NN/(2*NN+1)/(2*LL)
    u3=(2*NN+1)/(2*NN)*(a+s)-(ap+s)/(2*NN)-LL/(2*NN-i)*(y-xs)
    return c1*u1**2+c2*u2**2+c3*u3**2

def potential(e,x,j):
    ff,gg,xs=e["f"],e["g"],e["xs"]
    d=x-xs
    return (-LL/(4*NN)*(e["x0"]-xs)**2
            +LL*(NN-j)/(2*NN-j)**2*d**2-d*ff.grad(x)/(2*NN-j)
            +(ff.grad(x)-ff.grad(xs))**2/(2*LL*(2*NN-j))
            +(j+1)/(2*NN-j)*(ff(x)-ff(xs))
            +j/(2*NN-j)*(gg(x)-gg(xs)))

ff,gg,xs,y=e["f"],e["g"],e["xs"],e["y"]
    return ff(y)+gg(y)-ff(xs)-gg(xs)-LL/(4*NN)*(e["x0"]-xs)**2

def step_rhs(e,k):
    x,y,xs=e["x"],e["y"],e["xs"]
    denom=(2*NN-k-1)*(2*NN-k)
    return ((2*NN+1)/denom*I_f(e,xs,y)
           +2*NN/denom*I_g(e,xs,y)
           +(k+1)/(2*NN-k)*I_f(e,x,y)
           +k/(2*NN-k)*I_g(e,x,y)-Q_step(e,k+1))

x,y,xs=e["x"],e["y"],e["xs"]
    return (1/(NN+1)*I_f(e,xs,y)+2/(NN+1)*I_g(e,xs,y)
           +NN/(NN+1)*I_f(e,x,y)+(NN-1)/(NN+1)*I_g(e,x,y)
           -Q_step(e,NN))

def components(expression,ctx,values=None):
    vals=symbolic_values if values is None else values
    manager=pf.ExpressionManager(ctx,resolve_parameters=vals)
    evaluated=manager.eval_scalar(expression,sympy_mode=True)
    gram=sp.Matrix(evaluated.inner_prod_coords).applyfunc(sp.factor)
    funcs=sp.Matrix(list(evaluated.func_coords)).applyfunc(sp.factor)
    offset=sp.factor(evaluated.offset)
    return gram,funcs,offset

def If(ff,u,v,ell):
    return ff(v)-ff(u)+ff.grad(v)*(u-v)+(ff.grad(u)-ff.grad(v))**2/(2*ell)

def Ig(gg,u,v):
    return gg(v)-gg(u)+gg.grad(v)*(u-v)

def alpha(i,n):
    return i/(2*n+1-i)

def beta(i,n):
    return i/(2*n-i)

def local_square_piece(x,y,star,ff,gg,i,n,ell):
    ap,a,astar,s = ff.grad(x),ff.grad(y),ff.grad(star),gg.grad(y)
    c1 = n/((2*n+1-i)*(2*n-i)*ell)
    c2 = ((i-1)/(2*n-i)*(2*n+2)/(2*n+1)+2*n/((2*n-i)**2*(2*n+1)))/(2*ell)
    c3 = i/(2*n+1-i)*(2*n)/(2*n+1)/(2*ell)
    u1 = i/(2*n)*a+(2*n-i)/(2*n)*ap-astar
    u2 = ap+s-ell/(2*n+1-i)*(x-star)
    u3 = (2*n+1)/(2*n)*(a+s)-(ap+s)/(2*n)-ell/(2*n-i)*(y-star)
    return c1*u1**2+c2*u2**2+c3*u3**2

    value = manager.eval_scalar(expression,sympy_mode=True)
    gram = sp.Matrix(value.inner_prod_coords).applyfunc(lambda z:sp.factor(sp.cancel(z)))
    funcs = sp.Matrix(list(value.func_coords)).applyfunc(lambda z:sp.factor(sp.cancel(z)))
    offset = sp.factor(sp.cancel(sp.sympify(value.offset)))
    return gram,funcs,offset

    from pgm_setup import get_pep_setup,f,g,L
    k,n=sp.symbols("k n",nonnegative=True)
    N=k+1+n
    alpha,beta,gamma,*_=sos_coefficients(k,N)
    A=k**2+2*k*n+4*k+4*n+3
    B=k**4+4*k**3*n+8*k**3+4*k**2*n**2+22*k**2*n+18*k**2+12*k*n**2+28*k*n+16*k+4*n**2+10*n+5
    P=k**4+5*k**3*n+3*k**3+8*k**2*n**2+13*k**2*n+3*k**2+4*k*n**3+16*k*n**2+13*k*n+k+4*n**3+10*n**2+5*n
    identities=[alpha-A/(2*(k+2*n+1)**2),
                beta-B/(2*(k+2*n+1)**2*A),
                gamma-k*P/((k+2*n+2)**2*B)]
    residuals=[sp.factor(v) for v in identities]
    assert residuals==[0,0,0]
    assert all(coef>0 for poly in (A,B,P) for coef in sp.Poly(poly,k,n).coeffs())
    print("Pivot positive-polynomial identities:",residuals)

k,N=sp.symbols("k N", integer=True)
    t,u=sp.symbols("t u")
    d,p,q,s=sp.symbols("d p q s")
    a=lambda j:(j+1)/(2*N-j)
    b=lambda j:j/(2*N-j)
    A=lambda j:(N-j)/(2*N-j)**2
    c=lambda j:1/(2*N-j)
    dn=d-p-s
    Ifstar=-q*dn+q*q/2
    Igstar=-s*dn
    Ifstep=q*(d-dn)+(p-q)**2/2
    Igstep=s*(d-dn)
    V=A(k)*d*d-c(k)*d*p-t*p*p
    W=A(k+1)*dn*dn-c(k+1)*dn*q-u*q*q
    S=sp.expand((a(k+1)-a(k))*Ifstar+(b(k+1)-b(k))*Igstar+a(k)*Ifstep+b(k)*Igstep-W+V)
    vec=sp.Matrix([q,s,d,p])
    M=sp.hessian(S,vec)/2
    M=M.applyfunc(sp.factor)
    print("S matrix",M)
    rem=M.copy()
    pivots=[]
    factors=[]

pivot=sp.factor(rem[j,j])
        row=(rem[:,j]/pivot).applyfunc(sp.factor)

rem=(rem-pivot*row*row.T).applyfunc(sp.factor)
    print("pivots",pivots)
    print("factors",factors)
    print("remainder",rem)
    recurrence=sp.solve(rem[3,3],t)[0]
    print("t recurrence:",sp.factor(recurrence))
    m,r=sp.symbols("m r")
    scaled=sp.factor((2*(2*N-k)**2/k)*recurrence)

    print("SIMPLE pivots",[sp.factor(v.subs(chosen)) for v in pivots])
    print("SIMPLE factors",[v.subs(chosen).applyfunc(sp.factor) for v in factors])
    print("SIMPLE residual",sp.factor(rem[3,3].subs(chosen)))
    n=sp.symbols("n",nonnegative=True)

def z_product(k,N):
    P,Q=sp.Integer(N),sp.Integer(2*(N+1)**2)
    for j in reversed(range(k,N-1)):
        m=2*N-j
        A=2*(j+1)*(m-1)*((j+2)*m*(m-1)-(j+1))
        B=(j+1)**2*(m-2)*(2*N+1)
        C=4*m*m*(m-1)*((2*j+3)*m-(3*j+4))
        D=2*m*m*(m-2)*(j+1)*(j+2)
        P,Q=A*P+B*Q,C*P+D*Q
    return P/Q

def normalized_U(k,z,x,xnext,anchor,xs,fs,gs,L,N):
